content.name: Lena Hoffmann
content.title: Front-End Lead
content.summary: Front-end lead with 15 years in Hamburg, trained first as a Fachinformatikerin and then in media computer science. Leads eight developers building the customer portal of a digital insurer with 600,000 policyholders, and led its readiness work for the Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz (BFSG). Focused on React, TypeScript and design systems that teams actually adopt.

experience.title: Web Developer
bullets: Built responsive publishing templates for regional magazine websites with about 4 million monthly page views.
Introduced Grunt-based build tooling and code linting, reducing broken releases from several a month to roughly one a quarter.
Trained editorial staff on the new templates in German and wrote the internal style guide.

experience.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Developed the Angular package-holiday search for German, Austrian and Swiss markets, handling 50,000 searches a day.
Implemented SEPA direct debit and invoice payment options in checkout, which German customers preferred over cards.
Raised booking conversion on tablets by 12% after rebuilding filters and date pickers for touch.

experience.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
bullets: Led migration of a fashion marketplace from AngularJS to React and TypeScript over 18 months without a feature freeze.
Designed a micro-frontend setup that let five teams release independently, increasing weekly front-end deploys from 3 to 25.
Implemented a consent-management flow that met GDPR and TTDSG requirements while keeping analytics opt-in near 60%.
Interviewed and hired four front-end engineers for the Hamburg office.

experience.title: Front-End Lead
bullets: Lead eight front-end developers across two squads delivering the customer portal for 600,000 policyholders.
Ran the BFSG accessibility readiness project ahead of June 2025, auditing 220 screens and fixing over 400 WCAG issues.
Built a shared React component library with Storybook and design tokens, now used by every customer-facing product.
Reduced claims-form drop-off by 19% through a step-by-step flow tested with older customers in usability sessions.

education.school: Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften Hamburg (HAW Hamburg)

education.degree: Fachinformatikerin für Anwendungsentwicklung (IHK) – vocational training in application development

achievements.title: Speaker at a German front-end conference
achievements.detail: Talk on preparing insurance portals for the BFSG, attended by about 300 developers.

achievements.title: Mentor, women-in-tech programme in Hamburg
achievements.detail: Mentored six career changers into their first developer roles.

interests: Volunteering at a Hamburg repair café
